gloss: to grow fat; to become fertile; to become refined

definitions.gloss: to grow fat; to become plump
definitions.explanation: To gain weight and become fat. Used for people and animals.

definitions.gloss: to become fertile; to become rich (of soil)
definitions.explanation: For land or soil to become nutrient-rich and productive.

definitions.gloss: to become refined; to become discerning
definitions.explanation: For one's eye, palate, or ear to develop refined taste through experience.

examples.english: Bears fatten up in autumn to prepare for winter.

examples.english: Well-fattened pigs were sent to market.

examples.english: Vegetables grown in rich soil are delicious.

examples.english: I have a refined palate, so I can't be satisfied with cheap wine.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive ichidan verb. Pair: ⟦{肥|こ}やす→肥やす：28712_koyasu⟧ (to fatten; to fertilize).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肥|こ}えた⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧: fertile land
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{肥|こ}える: to develop a discerning eye
- ⟦{舌|した}→舌：02154_shita⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{肥|こ}える: to develop a refined palate
- ⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{肥|こ}える: to develop a discerning ear

SIMILAR WORDS:
For a person putting on weight, everyday Japanese says ⟦{太|ふと}る→太る：01190_futoru⟧. {肥|こ}える in sense 1 is used mainly of animals and livestock; said of a person it sounds old-fashioned.

WATCH OUT:
⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧ (to exceed) and ⟦{越|こ}える→越える：02099_koeru⟧ (to cross over) are different words with the same reading.
